description: K.P.S.M. Lal Pathirana & K.P. Siriyalatha Kalyani v. R.A. Shriyamali Gunawardena & Others K.P.S.M. Lal Pathirana & K.P. Siriyalatha Kalyani v. R.A. Shriyamali Gunawardena & Others View More before Hon. Vijith K. Malalgoda, PC, J (P/CA)
parties: K.P.S.M. Lal Pathirana & K.P. Siriyalatha Kalyani v. R.A. Shriyamali Gunawardena & Others K.P.S.M. Lal Pathirana & K.P. Siriyalatha Kalyani v. R.A. Shriyamali Gunawardena & Others View More
judgement_by: Hon. Vijith K. Malalgoda, PC, J (P/CA)
keywords: Writ application – Debt Conciliation Board – Deed characterized as mortgage rather than transfer – Valuation of property – Petitioners alleging Board had mistaken 2011 valuation for 2001 valuation – Board aware of relevant valuation date – Consideration that value in 2001 substantially exceeded Rs.150,000 stated in deed – Statutory power to treat transaction as mortgage – No basis for writ intervention – Notice refused – Application dismissed. S. Thurairaja PC J. agreed.
legistation: Debt Conciliation Ordinance/Act – section 25(1)(A), (B) and (C), as identified in the order; Constitution – Article 140.
